issues: 六面只有一个标题 + 4 条色条 + 一个 Unicode 角标，换了色相也读不出各面是什么模块
正面特写时标题被顶出画面上沿（OVERVIEW 只剩半截），内容没避开特写裁切区
DesignStage 用 transform scale 放大 480×270 设计稿，小字和细边在 4 倍放大后发软
相机推拉与转向在同一窗口同一缓动下同步走，转面读作机械插值
收尾等轴位立方体底角贴着画框下沿
changes: 六面换成真实模块界面：Overview 指标 + 面积折线 + 两枚小卡、Metrics 金额 + 周柱图、Timeline 四个里程碑、Assets 文件列表、Settings 开关、Export 格式选择 + 主按钮；保留每面独立色相作面身份
内容区整体下移到 y 28–168，避开特写时上下各 ~19px 的出画区；标题字距从 0.27em 收到 0.14em
DesignStage 改 raster="zoom"，面上文字按成片尺寸栅格化，特写也锐利
相机推拉轴错开 2% 时间：拉远段先退后转、推近段先转后进（overlap）；CAM 表、五段窗口与 inOutCubic 不变，仅收尾等轴 d −95→−165 让尾帧立方体完整入画
面上叠随法线明暗变化的左上受光 + 1px 棱边高光，立方体下方加随当前面色相过渡的地面光晕，整幅加暗角与颗粒；删掉为对齐旧样片做的 R 通道压暗补丁
issuesEn: Each face had only a title, four colour bars and a Unicode glyph — even with distinct hues you couldn't tell what module a face was
In the front close-up the title was pushed off the top edge (OVERVIEW half cut); content ignored the close-up crop zone
DesignStage upscaled the 480×270 design with transform scale, so small text and thin edges went soft at 4×
Dolly and rotation moved in lockstep on the same window and curve, so face turns read as mechanical interpolation
In the final isometric pose the cube's bottom corner touched the frame edge
changesEn: Faces are now real module UIs: Overview metric + area line + two mini tiles, Metrics revenue + weekly bars, Timeline four milestones, Assets file list, Settings toggles, Export format picker + primary button; each face keeps its own hue as identity
Content moved to y 28–168, clear of the ~19px cropped top/bottom in close-ups; title tracking reduced from 0.27em to 0.14em
DesignStage switched to raster="zoom" so face text rasterises at output size and stays sharp in close-ups

The dolly axis is offset by 2% of the timeline — pull back before turning, turn before pushing in (overlap); CAM table, the five windows and inOutCubic are unchanged, except the closing isometric d −95→−165 so the last frame holds the whole cube

Faces get a normal-driven top-left light and a 1px edge highlight, a floor glow under the cube blends between the current faces' hues, plus vignette and grain; removed the red-channel crush hack that only existed to match the old sample video
